changeSet.createView: SELECT CAST(CONCAT('CONSULTATION-', c.id) AS CHAR(64)) AS composite_key, c.id AS source_id, c.animal_id AS animal_id, c.company_id AS company_id, NULLIF(c.id, c.id) AS consultation_id, c.date AS event_date, CAST('CONSULTATION' AS CHAR(32)) AS event_type, CAST(ct.name AS CHAR(255)) AS summary FROM consultations c JOIN consultation_types ct ON ct.id = c.consultation_type_id UNION ALL SELECT CAST(CONCAT('SURGERY-', s.id) AS CHAR(64)), s.id, s.animal_id, s.company_id, s.consultation_id, s.date, CAST('SURGERY' AS CHAR(32)), CAST(st.name AS CHAR(255)) FROM surgeries s JOIN surgery_types st ON st.id = s.surgery_type_id UNION ALL SELECT CAST(CONCAT('VACCINATION-', v.id) AS CHAR(64)), v.id, v.animal_id, v.company_id, v.consultation_id, v.date, CAST('VACCINATION' AS CHAR(32)), CAST(vt.name AS CHAR(255)) FROM vaccinations v JOIN vaccination_types vt ON vt.id = v.vaccination_type_id UNION ALL SELECT CAST(CONCAT('DEWORMING-', d.id) AS CHAR(64)), d.id, d.animal_id, d.company_id, d.consultation_id, d.date, CAST('DEWORMING' AS CHAR(32)), CAST(d.product AS CHAR(255)) FROM dewormings d UNION ALL SELECT CAST(CONCAT('HOSPITALIZATION-', h.id) AS CHAR(64)), h.id, h.animal_id, h.company_id, h.consultation_id, h.start_date, CAST('HOSPITALIZATION' AS CHAR(32)), CAST(LEFT(h.reason, 255) AS CHAR(255)) FROM hospitalizations h UNION ALL SELECT CAST(CONCAT('LABORATORY_TEST-', l.id) AS CHAR(64)), l.id, l.animal_id, l.company_id, l.consultation_id, l.date, CAST('LABORATORY_TEST' AS CHAR(32)), CAST(lt.name AS CHAR(255)) FROM laboratory_tests l JOIN laboratory_test_types lt ON lt.id = l.test_type_id UNION ALL SELECT CAST(CONCAT('DIAGNOSTIC_IMAGING-', di.id) AS CHAR(64)), di.id, di.animal_id, di.company_id, di.consultation_id, di.date, CAST('DIAGNOSTIC_IMAGING' AS CHAR(32)), CAST(dit.name AS CHAR(255)) FROM diagnostic_imagings di JOIN diagnostic_imaging_types dit ON dit.id = di.diagnostic_imaging_type_id UNION ALL SELECT CAST(CONCAT('PRESCRIPTION-', p.id) AS CHAR(64)), p.id, p.animal_id, p.company_id, p.consultation_id, p.date, CAST('PRESCRIPTION' AS CHAR(32)), CAST(LEFT(p.diagnosis, 255) AS CHAR(255)) FROM prescriptions p UNION ALL SELECT CAST(CONCAT('SPA-', sp.id) AS CHAR(64)), sp.id, sp.animal_id, sp.company_id, NULLIF(sp.id, sp.id) AS consultation_id, sp.date, CAST('SPA' AS CHAR(32)), CAST(spt.name AS CHAR(255)) FROM spas sp JOIN spa_types spt ON spt.id = sp.spa_type_id
